none: PAS NLM-C59714: Roman Curse Tablet with Post-Medieval Finger Ring
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Lead possible Curse Tablet. Rectangular plate cut from cast sheet of thickness 2.5mm, neatly rolled into a loose tube. Patinated overall, and with soil trapped within. As a curse tablet, the lead object, like a miniature axehead and numerous later Roman coins, may hint at the proximity of a temple or shrine. Suggested date of the curse tablet: Roman, 40-400.
